statements.impact_statement: The advisory requires xds.NewGRPCServer. The pinned SeaweedFS executable contains ordinary grpc.NewServer but not the xDS server constructor or xds/internal/server code. Its master/filer/volume use pb.NewGrpcServer, which constructs grpc.NewServer. The grpc dependency remains in the advisory's version range; this statement is limited to the linked executable in this image.
statements.action_statement: Upgrade to a stable SeaweedFS image with a patched gRPC version when available. Any digest/component/advisory change or expiry requires fresh assessment; native symbol controls are rechecked on every adjudication.
